nodes.title: The second-play colour difference (fd-second-play-changes-colours-p412) is a first-play extra: an engine makes one or two more colour draws on its first play in a process (angle-cannon p412 279,234 then 279,233), something built once and kept. The colour-trace test now runs in its own process and passes in any order; the leak check is usable again. What is built once is still to be named by Studio
